title: Conditional κ = 0.001672746568309053: optimal 27-role re-packing on child 15
body:
### Summary
This PR establishes a further verified conditional exponent saving record for integer multiplication:
- **Exact rational κ:** `1672746568309053 / 1000000000000000000`
- **Decimal κ:** `0.001672746568309053` (conservative: `0.001672746565457453`)
- **Preceding Record:** `0.001672733678608451`
- **Baseline:** PR #1104 (`d8982686`), κ = `0.001672691689152441`
- **Strict Gain over Baseline:** `+54879156612 / 10^18` (+5.487915661e-8, +0.00328%)

### Mechanism & Optimization
In our previous step, 18 remainder-11 bins on child 15 ports 94..111 were exchanged into 9 remainder-20 bins and 9 remainder-2 bins.
In this update, we formulate and solve the global CP-SAT maximum-concentration re-packing across the 9 ports `[94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 101, 108]` for all 27 width-4 roles:
- Solves the exact call-disjointness constraints: no port may contain more than 1 role from the same `(stage, replica)` call (calls present: `(5, 15)` [8], `(6, 14)` [5], `(6, 12)` [4], `(8, 5)` [4], `(6, 5)` [3], `(7, 11)` [2], `(6, 6)` [1]).
- Derives the optimal concentration partition `(7, 6, 5, 4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)`, converting the remainder profile from nine remainder-20 bins into `[4, 8, 12, 16, 28, 28, 28, 28, 28]`.
- Total rank mass deficit across the 9 ports remains strictly conserved: $4 + 8 + 12 + 16 + 5 \times 28 = 180 = 9 \times 20$.
- By Karamata's inequality and strict concavity of $\phi(r) = r (73/r)^z$, this majorization strictly reduces the complex moment by $\approx -0.97$, directly driving $\kappa$ up to `0.001672746568309053`.

### Verification
- `python -B research/gauge44-ends7-t16/verify_manifest.py` -> `PASS package manifest: 197 files`
- `python -B research/gauge44-ends7-t16/verify_t16.py --main . --local /tmp/ends7/local --work /tmp/work` -> `PASS_GAUGE44_T16_STRICT_GLOBAL_REPLAY 0.001672746568309053`
- All 69 admission controls, 12 bit controls, 15 controller mutations, 6 independent T16 controls, and 47 strict outer inequalities pass cleanly.

### Generators Included
- `research/gauge44-ends7-t16/exchange_remainder11.py`: First-stage 9-pair whole-helper exchange.
- `research/gauge44-ends7-t16/repack_rem20.py`: Second-stage 27-role optimal concentration partition solver and generator.

### Credits & Disclosures
- Builds directly on PR #1104 and #1087 by Jeremy Kothe (ends7 and T16 owner packing), PR #1094 by Rohan Arun, PR #1030 by Alexander Schwartzman (Scale), PR #858 by FanPUYen, and the PR589 bit supplier.
- Prepared with autonomous AI pair-programming assistance (Google Antigravity).
- Retains conditional assumptions: PR589 bit supplier, all-size compiler, mutable-source realization, precision/tape, analytic transfer. Finite certificate success is not a formal proof of the unconditional multiplication theorem and does not measure runtime speedup.
